drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:retention-and-referral row: steps apply-the-reward-rule, record-the-stage and their submit shapes); no test names it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:retention-and-referral for my bakery: Sam asked for a referral code, and my reward is a free loaf for every 3 friends who buy."

lists.label: Business setup checklist
lists.holds: One row per stage of setting the business up; this workflow writes the replies row.

lists.label: Business setup gaps
lists.holds: One row per thing a stage could not do itself: the step, what was left undecided, what the run did and the evidence.

values.undecided: No live tool stores testimonials, so a buyer's reply has no home of its own.
values.chosen: Sent the ask only to a buyer who agreed, and kept the reply in that buyer's customer record.
values.evidence: The retention-and-referral row says testimonials are not stored by any live tool.

values.undecided: facts.referral_reward was empty, so no reward words existed.
values.chosen: Submitted a blocker and wrote no reward row; the owner writes the reward in the facts row.
values.evidence: records:read on record:business-setup:facts showed referral_reward empty.

alike: a blockers column on a board

instructions: 1. Pour the two example setup-checklist rows into the checklist you already keep (see pour), or make list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps from them.

2. Make sure the facts row record:business-setup:facts exists (workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion writes it) and holds referral_reward in your own words, for example "A free loaf for every 3 friends who buy".

3. Say "Run workflow:retention-and-referral". It finds buyers quiet for more than 14 days, runs workflow:follow-up-with-people-who-engaged for them, makes and counts referral codes, writes a reward row only from your reward words, withdraws a code you name, and asks for a testimonial only after consent.
4. Read the last step: record-the-stage writes record:setup-stage:retention-and-referral and one record:setup-gap row for each thing no live tool did (testimonial storage is one).

worked_examples.title: A buyer earns a reward under the owner's own reward words
worked_examples.ask: Sam referred friends; apply my reward rule for Sam today.
worked_examples.given: Read from the workflow:retention-and-referral row (tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json), step apply-the-reward-rule: facts.referral_reward is "A free loaf for every 3 friends who buy", count-referrals answered referrals 4 and rewards_due 1 for the buyer account acct-sam, and today is 2026-11-13.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"reward_row":"record:reward:acct-sam-2026-11-13"}: the step wrote that row at @own-records with {"account":"acct-sam","reward":"A free loaf for every 3 friends who buy","due":1,"status":"due"} and read it back with records:read.

worked_examples.title: No reward words yet: the stage stops instead of inventing one
worked_examples.ask: Apply my reward rule for Sam today.
worked_examples.given: Read from the same step: facts.referral_reward is empty. The step says no reward is invented and the person writes it in the facts row.
worked_examples.hands_back: A blocker for this step ("referral_reward is empty in record:business-setup:facts") and no record:reward row written; record-the-stage then marks the stage Gap and writes record:setup-gap:apply-the-reward-rule-1.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
